verdict.rationale: The Convex CLI watches local files and pushes functions and schema to a dev deployment, and `npx convex run` executes functions there before production ([convex-docs-17], [convex-docs-18]). The open-source backend can also be self-hosted on your own servers, including with SQLite ([convex-docs-8], [convex-gh-1]), which implies it could run on a local machine. However, the documented dev loop targets a dev deployment rather than an explicit local emulator, and self-hosting is not framed as a local-dev workflow. Missing for 10: explicit docs for running the full backend locally (a local deployment or emulator mode), a documented offline dev workflow, and hands-on corroboration of local running.
